findings.description: The plan turns Windows native evidence into implementation and completion gates, which the constitution forbids: Step 1 success requires both native platforms, Step 2 depends on Step 1, and Step 7 success requires no missing platform proof. On a macOS-only implementation host this blocks Step 2 onward or forces a false claim. The constitution makes such evidence pending release evidence that never blocks implementation steps, feature completion on the integration branch or the dev merge.
findings.suggestion: Restate Windows native spike and acceptance as pending release evidence with exact checks (as the 008 plan does); keep Windows compilation and automated tests as gates and macOS native evidence as the Implemented gate.

findings.description: Unsupported-platform refusal is planned as `unavailable`/exit 5 with reason/platform in details. In the 008 contract exit 5 means an absent, busy, older or timed-out owner whose outcome must be reread before retrying, and the 008 implementation merged in dev (HEAD 0fb75ae) has a closed error-details schema (current_revision, outcome, field, offset, issues; additionalProperties false) with no reason or platform field; its precedent for an environment refusal (updater disabled) is validation_failed with a typed reason. Feature 007 refuses smart_paste outside macOS with validation_failed/2. Following this plan would either break the 008 envelope schema or diverge from 007 for the same class of refusal, and would tell agents to retry a permanent refusal.
findings.suggestion: Decide one platform-refusal contract shared with 007 (for example validation_failed/2 with a new typed ValidationReason on `field`), or explicitly plan the 008 schema/README extension; also state how an offline CLI (no running instance) evaluates runtime capability, since the 008 Domain::plan and ValidationContext carry no capability input.

findings.description: The InsertionPort is specified only as a guard wrapper; the plan does not define what destination context it hands to the insertion method. The 007 smart-paste plan expects a `DestinationContext` (PID, bundle ID, destination generation) from 006/009 and its direct AX insertion only acts when the focused element belongs to the destination process, also when no destination was captured (frontmost at the end). Generation naming also differs (006 session_id/cancel_generation versus 007 dictation_id/destination_generation) and 006 uses prose outcome names where 007 uses wire values (inserted_verified, read_observed, ...).
findings.suggestion: Add to the destination contract a DestinationContext produced at dispatch for every path (captured, badge choice, FrontmostAtEnd resolved at insertion) with PID, stable identity and generation, and a mapping table to the 007 PasteOutcome wire values and identifiers.
